rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person or animal that refuses to obey or cooperate.

example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 gau2 zan1 hai6 m4 teng1 waa6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that the person, animal, or thing is difficult to handle rather than simply disobedient.

example.english: This old printer is really balky; it keeps jamming.
example.traditional: 呢部舊打印機真係難搞，成日卡住。
example.jyutping: nei1 bou6 gau6 daa2 jan3 gei1 zan1 hai6 naan4 gaau2 seng4 jat6 kaa1 zyu6

rows.note: Use this especially for a person or group that is explicitly unwilling to cooperate.

example.english: That group is really balky; they won't even discuss the motion.
example.traditional: 嗰班人好唔合作，連議案都唔肯討論。
example.jyutping: go2 baan1 jan4 hou2 m4 hap6 zok3 lin4 ji5 on3 dou1 m4 hang2 tou2 leon6
